tools.photo-watermark-remover.faqs.2.ans: The tool accepts PNG, JPG, JPEG, WebP, and any other image format your browser supports. The output is always downloaded as a high-quality PNG file regardless of the input format.
tools.photo-watermark-remover.faqs.3.que: Can I remove text overlays and logos from photos?
tools.photo-watermark-remover.faqs.3.ans: Yes. Paint over any text, logo, or graphic overlay with the brush and the inpainting algorithm will attempt to reconstruct the background behind it. Results work best on photos with relatively uniform or textured backgrounds.
tools.photo-watermark-remover.faqs.4.que: Is there a maximum image size I can process?
tools.photo-watermark-remover.faqs.4.ans: There is no hard limit, but very large images (over 8000px) may be slow to process since the inpainting runs on the CPU in your browser. For best performance, images under 4000px wide work smoothly.
tools.photo-watermark-remover.faqs.5.que: Is my photo uploaded to a server?
tools.photo-watermark-remover.faqs.5.ans: No. All processing happens entirely in your browser. Your image never leaves your device, so your photos stay completely private.
tools.photo-watermark-remover.guide.what: What Is the Photo Watermark Remover?

The Photo Watermark Remover is a free online tool that removes watermarks, logos, text overlays, and other unwanted objects from images. It uses an inpainting algorithm that reconstructs the area behind the watermark based on surrounding pixel data.
Everything runs locally in your browser. Your photos are never uploaded to any server, which means your images stay completely private and processing is instant.
tools.photo-watermark-remover.guide.howT: How to Remove a Watermark from a Photo
Removing a watermark takes just a few steps:
Upload your image by clicking the upload area or dragging and dropping a file (PNG, JPG, or WebP).
Adjust the brush size using the slider or the keyboard shortcuts: press [ to decrease and ] to increase.
Paint over the watermark area. A red overlay shows what you have selected.
Click Remove Watermark to process the image.
Review the result and download your clean image as a full-resolution PNG.
tools.photo-watermark-remover.guide.algo: The tool uses a pixel-based inpainting technique that analyzes the colors and textures around the masked area. It progressively fills in pixels from the boundary inward, sampling nearby regions to reconstruct a natural-looking background. This approach works especially well on textured surfaces, gradients, and photographs with organic patterns.
tools.photo-watermark-remover.guide.tips: Use a brush size that closely matches the thickness of the watermark text or logo for precise coverage.
Paint slightly beyond the edges of the watermark to catch semi-transparent pixels.
For large watermarks covering complex areas, process in smaller sections — paint and remove one area at a time.
Results are best on photos with textured or varied backgrounds. Watermarks over faces or fine detail may require touch-up.

tools.qr-code-generator.faqs.0.question: How do I create a QR code for a URL?
tools.qr-code-generator.faqs.0.answer: Paste your URL into the text field and the QR code generates instantly. You can customize the size, colors, and error correction level, then download it as a PNG or copy it to your clipboard.
tools.qr-code-generator.faqs.1.question: What is QR code error correction and which level should I use?
tools.qr-code-generator.faqs.1.answer: Error correction allows a QR code to be scanned even if part of it is damaged or obscured. Medium (15%) is a good default. Use High (30%) if you plan to place a logo over the QR code or print it on materials that may get scratched.
tools.qr-code-generator.faqs.2.question: Can I customize the colors of my QR code?
tools.qr-code-generator.faqs.2.answer: Yes. You can set both the foreground and background colors using the color pickers or by entering hex values directly. Make sure there is enough contrast between the two colors for scanners to read the code reliably.
tools.qr-code-generator.faqs.3.question: What is the maximum amount of data a QR code can hold?
tools.qr-code-generator.faqs.3.answer: A QR code can store up to about 4,296 alphanumeric characters or 7,089 numeric digits. For practical use, URLs under 500 characters work best and produce QR codes that are easy to scan.
tools.qr-code-generator.faqs.4.question: Is this QR code generator free to use?
tools.qr-code-generator.faqs.4.answer: Yes, it is completely free with no signup required. The QR codes are generated in your browser and there are no limits on how many you can create or download.
tools.qr-code-generator.faqs.5.question: Can I use the generated QR codes for commercial purposes?
tools.qr-code-generator.faqs.5.answer: Yes. The QR codes you generate are yours to use however you like, including on printed materials, products, business cards, and marketing campaigns. There are no restrictions.
tools.qr-code-generator.guide.whatIs.tit: What Is the QR Code Generator?
tools.qr-code-generator.guide.whatIs.bod: This QR Code Generator lets you create customizable QR codes from any text or URL instantly. You can adjust the output size, foreground and background colors, and error correction level. The generated QR code can be downloaded as a PNG image or copied directly to your clipboard.
QR codes are two-dimensional barcodes that can be scanned by smartphones and dedicated readers. They are widely used for sharing URLs, contact information, Wi-Fi credentials, and other data quickly.
tools.qr-code-generator.guide.howTo.titl: How to Create a QR Code
tools.qr-code-generator.guide.howTo.intr: Creating a QR code takes seconds:
tools.qr-code-generator.guide.howTo.item: Type or paste your text or URL into the input field. The QR code generates automatically as you type.
Choose a size from the dropdown (128px to 1024px).
Select an error correction level. Medium (15%) is the recommended default.
Optionally customize the foreground and background colors using the color pickers.
Click Download PNG to save the image, or Copy Image to place it on your clipboard.
tools.qr-code-generator.guide.errorCorre: QR codes include redundant data that allows them to be read even when partially damaged. The four error correction levels determine how much damage a code can tolerate:
Low (7%) — Smallest code size, least redundancy. Use when the QR code will always be displayed on a clean screen.
Medium (15%) — Good balance of size and reliability. Best for most use cases.
Quartile (25%) — Higher redundancy. Good for printed materials that may get scratched.
High (30%) — Maximum redundancy. Required if you plan to overlay a logo on the QR code.
tools.qr-code-generator.guide.tips.title: Tips for Creating Effective QR Codes
tools.qr-code-generator.guide.tips.items: Keep your URLs short. Shorter data produces simpler QR codes that scan faster and more reliably.
Maintain high contrast between foreground and background colors. Dark on light is most reliable.
Test your QR code on multiple devices before printing or publishing.
Use at least 256px for print materials and 512px or larger for posters and signage.
tools.qr-code-generator.guide.useCases.i: Business cards linking to a website or contact page.
Restaurant menus accessible via table QR codes.
Product packaging linking to instructions or warranty registration.
tools.qr-code-generator.logo.ecHint: To keep the QR code scannable, error correction is upgraded to Q (25%) while a logo is present.

tools.qr-file-transfer.metadata.title: QR File Transfer - Send Files Between Devices Offline
tools.qr-file-transfer.metadata.descript: Send files and text between two devices via animated QR codes. One screen shows a stream of codes your camera scans to rebuild the file — no network, fully offline.
tools.qr-file-transfer.title: QR File Transfer
tools.qr-file-transfer.description: Send files and text between two devices through a stream of animated QR codes. One screen emits the codes, the other device's camera scans them and rebuilds the file locally — no network, no servers, nothing is uploaded.
tools.qr-file-transfer.faqs.0.question: How does QR file transfer work?
tools.qr-file-transfer.faqs.0.answer: One device (the sender) displays an endless stream of animated QR codes encoding the file. The other device's camera scans the codes and the receiver rebuilds the file from them. The fountain coding used means any subset of the frames is enough — dropped frames only cost time, never correctness.
tools.qr-file-transfer.faqs.1.question: Is my data uploaded anywhere?
tools.qr-file-transfer.faqs.1.answer: No. The whole transfer happens between the two screens — nothing is uploaded, nothing is stored, and no network connection is needed between the devices.
tools.qr-file-transfer.faqs.2.question: What is the maximum file size?
tools.qr-file-transfer.faqs.2.answer: Files up to 64 MB are supported. Smaller files and text snippets transfer faster, and the tool compresses the file automatically when it helps.
tools.qr-file-transfer.faqs.3.question: How fast is the transfer?
tools.qr-file-transfer.faqs.3.answer: The speed depends on the camera and the QR density. At close range with a good camera you can expect several hundred KB/s; dense frames (2953 bytes per frame) are fastest phone-to-phone at close range.
tools.qr-file-transfer.faqs.4.question: Is the transfer secure?
tools.qr-file-transfer.faqs.4.answer: The data travels only as light from one screen to the other — no network, no intermediate server. Anyone with a camera in line of sight of the sending screen could read it, so it is best for trusted surroundings.

tools.face-detector.faqs.1.question: Does it recognize who a person is?
tools.face-detector.faqs.1.answer: No. The detector only finds the location of faces and draws bounding boxes with confidence scores. It does not identify or recognize individuals.
tools.face-detector.faqs.2.question: Can I process multiple images at once?
tools.face-detector.faqs.2.answer: Yes. Upload as many images as you like — each is processed automatically and the results are shown in a list with per-image face counts.
tools.face-detector.faqs.3.question: Is my photo uploaded anywhere?

tools.face-detector.faqs.4.question: How do I save the results?

tools.color-palette-generator.faqs.2.que: How do I lock a color in the palette?

tools.color-palette-generator.faqs.3.que: What color formats are shown for each swatch?

tools.color-palette-generator.faqs.4.que: Can I use these color palettes for my website or app?

tools.color-palette-generator.faqs.5.que: Is there a keyboard shortcut to generate new palettes?

tools.css-gradient-generator.title: CSS Gradient Generator
tools.css-gradient-generator.description: Build linear, radial, and conic CSS gradients with a visual editor.
tools.css-gradient-generator.faqs.0.ques: How do I create a CSS gradient with multiple colors?
tools.css-gradient-generator.faqs.0.answ: Add color stops using the '+ Add Stop' button. Each stop has a color value and a position percentage. The gradient smoothly transitions between all your color stops in order from 0% to 100%.
tools.css-gradient-generator.faqs.1.ques: What is the difference between linear, radial, and conic gradients?
tools.css-gradient-generator.faqs.1.answ: Linear gradients transition colors along a straight line at a given angle. Radial gradients radiate outward from a center point in a circle. Conic gradients sweep color transitions around a center point like a color wheel.
tools.css-gradient-generator.faqs.2.ques: Can I copy the generated CSS gradient code?
tools.css-gradient-generator.faqs.2.answ: Yes. The tool generates ready-to-use CSS code displayed below the preview. Click the copy button to copy the full background property to your clipboard and paste it directly into your stylesheet.
tools.css-gradient-generator.faqs.3.ques: How do I change the direction of a CSS linear gradient?
tools.css-gradient-generator.faqs.3.answ: Use the angle slider to set the gradient direction in degrees. 0 degrees points upward, 90 degrees points right, 180 degrees points down, and 270 degrees points left. You can set any value from 0 to 360.
tools.css-gradient-generator.faqs.4.ques: Are CSS gradients supported in all browsers?
tools.css-gradient-generator.faqs.4.answ: Yes. CSS gradients including linear-gradient, radial-gradient, and conic-gradient are supported in all modern browsers. Conic gradients have slightly less legacy support but work in Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge.
tools.css-gradient-generator.faqs.5.ques: How do I use gradient presets?
tools.css-gradient-generator.faqs.5.answ: Click any preset button like Sunset, Ocean, or Rainbow to instantly load a professionally designed gradient. You can then customize the colors, stops, type, and angle to match your design needs.
tools.css-gradient-generator.guide.whatI: What Is the CSS Gradient Generator?

The CSS Gradient Generator is a visual tool that helps you build beautiful CSS gradients without writing code by hand. Choose between linear, radial, and conic gradient types, adjust colors and positions, and get production-ready CSS instantly. Whether you are designing a hero background, a button hover effect, or a decorative overlay, this tool speeds up your workflow.
tools.css-gradient-generator.guide.howTo: How to Use the CSS Gradient Generator

Start by selecting your gradient type: linear, radial, or conic. Each type produces a different visual effect. For linear and conic gradients, adjust the angle slider to control the direction of the color transition.
Pick a gradient type using the toggle buttons at the top.
Set the angle with the slider (available for linear and conic types).
Edit existing color stops by changing their color or position values.
Add more color stops with the "+ Add Stop" button for complex gradients.
Remove extra stops by clicking the X icon next to any stop.
Try a preset like Sunset, Ocean, or Rainbow to get started quickly.
The live preview updates in real time as you make changes. When you are happy with the result, copy the generated CSS code and paste it directly into your project.
Use two or three color stops for clean, modern gradients. Adding too many stops can make gradients look muddy. Position your stops strategically: placing two similar colors close together creates a sharper transition, while spreading them apart produces a smoother blend.

Radial gradients work well for spotlight effects and button highlights. Conic gradients are great for pie-chart-style visuals and decorative backgrounds. Experiment with angles to find the direction that best complements your layout.

tools.css-gradient-generator.guide.why.b: Writing CSS gradient syntax by hand is tedious and error-prone, especially with multiple color stops. tools.box-shadow-generator.faqs.0.questi: How do I create a CSS box shadow?
tools.box-shadow-generator.faqs.0.answer: Use the sliders to set X offset, Y offset, blur radius, and spread. Choose a shadow color and toggle the inset option if needed. The tool generates the CSS code automatically and shows a live preview.
tools.box-shadow-generator.faqs.1.questi: Can I add multiple box shadows to one element?
tools.box-shadow-generator.faqs.1.answer: Yes. Click the '+ Add' button to create additional shadow layers. Each shadow has independent controls for offset, blur, spread, color, and inset. Multiple shadows are combined into a single CSS property.
tools.box-shadow-generator.faqs.2.questi: What is an inset box shadow?
tools.box-shadow-generator.faqs.2.answer: An inset box shadow renders inside the element instead of outside. It creates a pressed or recessed appearance, commonly used for input fields, cards, and neumorphic design patterns.
tools.box-shadow-generator.faqs.3.questi: What is the difference between blur and spread in box-shadow?
tools.box-shadow-generator.faqs.3.answer: Blur controls how soft or diffused the shadow edges appear. Spread controls the size of the shadow; positive values make it larger than the element, while negative values make it smaller.
tools.box-shadow-generator.faqs.4.questi: How do I make a subtle, modern box shadow?
tools.box-shadow-generator.faqs.4.answer: Use a small Y offset (4-8px), moderate blur (10-20px), zero spread, and a semi-transparent black color like rgba(0,0,0,0.1). This produces the soft, elevated look common in modern UI design.
tools.box-shadow-generator.faqs.5.questi: Can I copy the generated box-shadow CSS?
tools.box-shadow-generator.faqs.5.answer: Yes. The generated CSS code is displayed below the preview. Click the copy button to copy it to your clipboard and paste it directly into your stylesheet or component.
What Is the Box Shadow Generator?

The Box Shadow Generator is a visual CSS tool that lets you design box shadows without writing code manually. Adjust offsets, blur, spread, and color with intuitive sliders and see the result instantly. The tool supports multiple shadow layers and inset shadows, covering every common shadow pattern in web design.
tools.box-shadow-generator.guide.howTo.t: How to Use the Box Shadow Generator
tools.box-shadow-generator.guide.howTo.i: Start with the default shadow and use the sliders to adjust it to your liking. The preview box updates in real time so you can see exactly how the shadow looks.
Drag the X Offset slider to move the shadow left or right.
Drag the Y Offset slider to move the shadow up or down.
Adjust the Blur slider to control the softness of the shadow edges.
Adjust the Spread slider to grow or shrink the shadow size.
Pick a shadow color using the color picker or enter a hex value.
Check the Inset toggle to place the shadow inside the element.
tools.box-shadow-generator.guide.howTo.o: To add a second shadow layer, click "+ Add" and configure it separately. You can have as many shadow layers as you need. Click the X icon on a shadow tab to remove it.
tools.box-shadow-generator.guide.tips.bo: Subtle shadows create depth without overwhelming the design. For card-style elevation, use a small Y offset with moderate blur and low-opacity black. For dramatic effects, increase the blur and offset values. Layering two or three shadows at different sizes often produces more realistic depth than a single heavy shadow.

Inset shadows are useful for creating pressed button states, input focus rings, and neumorphic design patterns. Combine an inset shadow with an outer shadow for a polished, three-dimensional appearance.
tools.box-shadow-generator.guide.useCase: Card and panel elevation in dashboard layouts.
Button hover and active states with layered shadows.
Input field focus effects using inset shadows.
Neumorphic UI design with combined inset and outer shadows.
tools.box-shadow-generator.guide.why.tit: Why Use a Box Shadow Generator?
tools.box-shadow-generator.guide.why.bod: The box-shadow CSS property has five values to coordinate: X offset, Y offset, blur, spread, and color. Getting these right by hand requires constant browser refreshes. This generator lets you experiment visually and copy clean CSS code when you are satisfied, saving time and reducing guesswork.
tools.password-generator.metadata.title: Password Generator
tools.password-generator.metadata.descri: Generate strong, secure passwords with customizable options including length, character types, and bulk generation.
tools.password-generator.title: Password Generator
tools.password-generator.description: Generate strong, secure passwords with customizable options including length, character types, and bulk generation.
tools.password-generator.faqs.0.question: How do I generate a strong password?
tools.password-generator.faqs.0.answer: Use this tool to create a password with at least 16 characters that includes uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, and symbols. The strength meter will confirm when your settings produce a strong or very strong password.
tools.password-generator.faqs.1.question: Is this password generator safe to use?
tools.password-generator.faqs.1.answer: Yes. Passwords are generated using the Web Crypto API (crypto.getRandomValues), which provides cryptographically secure random numbers. No passwords are stored or transmitted — everything runs locally in your browser.
tools.password-generator.faqs.2.question: What makes a password strong?
tools.password-generator.faqs.2.answer: A strong password is long (12+ characters), uses a mix of character types (upper, lower, numbers, symbols), and avoids dictionary words or personal information. This generator handles all of that automatically.
tools.password-generator.faqs.3.question: Can I generate multiple passwords at once?
tools.password-generator.faqs.3.answer: Yes. Use the Bulk Generate section to create 5, 10, or 20 passwords at once with your current settings. You can copy them all at once or copy individual passwords.
tools.password-generator.faqs.4.question: What does Exclude Ambiguous Characters mean?
tools.password-generator.faqs.4.answer: Ambiguous characters are ones that look similar in many fonts, like 0 and O, 1 and l and I. Excluding them makes passwords easier to read and type manually, which is useful when you need to enter a password on a different device.
tools.password-generator.faqs.5.question: How long should my password be?
tools.password-generator.faqs.5.answer: For most accounts, 16 characters is a strong minimum. For high-security accounts like banking or email, consider 20 or more characters. This tool supports passwords up to 128 characters long.
tools.password-generator.guide.whatIs.bo: The Password Generator creates cryptographically secure random passwords using the Web Crypto API built into your browser. You can customize the length, choose which character types to include, exclude ambiguous characters, and generate passwords in bulk.

No passwords are stored or transmitted anywhere. Everything runs locally in your browser, and each password is generated using a cryptographically secure random number generator — the same standard used by password managers and security applications.
tools.password-generator.guide.howTo.tit: How to Generate a Secure Password
tools.password-generator.guide.howTo.int: Follow these steps to create a strong password:
tools.password-generator.guide.howTo.ite: Set your desired password length using the slider (4 to 128 characters). A minimum of 16 characters is recommended for most accounts.
Select which character types to include: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, numbers, and symbols.
Optionally check Exclude Ambiguous Characters to avoid characters like 0/O and 1/l/I that are easily confused.
Click Regenerate or refresh the page to get a new password with the same settings.
Click Copy to copy the password to your clipboard.
The strength meter evaluates your password based on length and character diversity. It rates passwords as Weak, Fair, Strong, or Very Strong. To reach Very Strong, use at least 20 characters with a mix of all four character types (uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and symbols).
tools.password-generator.guide.bulk.body: Need multiple passwords at once? Use the Bulk Generate section to create 5, 10, or 20 passwords in a single click. All generated passwords use your current settings. You can copy individual passwords or copy all of them at once as a newline-separated list.
tools.password-generator.guide.tips.item: Use a unique password for every account. Never reuse passwords across different services.
Store your passwords in a password manager rather than writing them down or saving them in a text file.
For accounts that support it, enable two-factor authentication in addition to using a strong password.
If you need to type a password manually (for example, on a TV or game console), use Exclude Ambiguous Characters to avoid confusion.
Creating strong passwords for new online accounts.
Generating API keys and tokens for development environments.
Bulk generating temporary passwords for team onboarding.
Creating database passwords and server credentials.

tools.unit-converter.metadata.title: Unit Converter
tools.unit-converter.metadata.descriptio: Convert between length, weight, temperature, data, and time units instantly.
The Unit Converter is a free online tool that lets you convert between common measurement units across five categories: length, weight, temperature, data storage, and time. Enter a value, pick your source and target units, and get an instant result with no page reloads.
All conversions happen in your browser in real time as you type. The tool also shows a complete reference table so you can see your value expressed in every available unit at once.
tools.unit-converter.guide.howToUse.titl: How to Use the Unit Converter
tools.unit-converter.guide.howToUse.step: Select a category tab: Length, Weight, Temperature, Data, or Time.
Choose your source unit in the From dropdown and your target unit in the To dropdown.
Type a number in the input field. The converted result updates instantly.
Click the swap button between the two columns to reverse the conversion direction. The current result becomes the new input value.
Scroll down to the reference table to see your value converted to all units in the selected category.
tools.unit-converter.guide.supportedCate: Length conversions include millimeters, centimeters, meters, kilometers, inches, feet, yards, and miles. Weight covers milligrams, grams, kilograms, ounces, pounds, and metric tons. Temperature handles Celsius, Fahrenheit, and Kelvin. Data storage converts between bytes, kilobytes, megabytes, gigabytes, terabytes, and petabytes. Time includes milliseconds, seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, months, and years.
tools.unit-converter.guide.tips.title: Tips for Accurate Conversions
tools.unit-converter.guide.tips.body: The converter uses precise conversion factors and displays results with up to 10 significant digits. Very small values are shown in scientific notation for clarity. Temperature conversions use the standard formulas relating Celsius, Fahrenheit, and Kelvin, not simple multiplication.
tools.unit-converter.guide.useCases.item: Converting between metric and imperial measurements for recipes, travel, or science
Calculating file and storage sizes across different data units
Converting time durations for project planning or scheduling
Quick reference when working with international standards or documentation
Homework and study aid for unit conversion problems
tools.unit-converter.faqs.0.question: How do I convert kilometers to miles?
tools.unit-converter.faqs.0.answer: Select the Length category, choose Kilometers as the From unit and Miles as the To unit, then enter your value. One kilometer equals approximately 0.6214 miles.
tools.unit-converter.faqs.1.question: How do I convert Celsius to Fahrenheit?
tools.unit-converter.faqs.1.answer: Select the Temperature category, choose Celsius as the From unit and Fahrenheit as the To unit. The formula used is F = C x 9/5 + 32. For example, 100 degrees Celsius equals 212 degrees Fahrenheit.
tools.unit-converter.faqs.2.question: What is the difference between MB and GB?
tools.unit-converter.faqs.2.answer: One gigabyte (GB) equals 1024 megabytes (MB). Select the Data category to convert between any data storage units from bytes up to petabytes.
tools.unit-converter.faqs.3.question: Can I convert between metric and imperial units?
tools.unit-converter.faqs.3.answer: Yes. The Length and Weight categories both include metric units (meters, kilograms) and imperial units (feet, pounds). Select any combination and the converter handles the math automatically.
tools.unit-converter.faqs.4.question: How many seconds are in a year?
tools.unit-converter.faqs.4.answer: There are approximately 31,557,600 seconds in a year. Enter 1 in the Time category with Years as the source and Seconds as the target to see this calculated instantly.
tools.unit-converter.faqs.5.question: Does this unit converter work offline?
tools.unit-converter.faqs.5.answer: Once the page has loaded, all conversions run entirely in your browser with no server requests. You can use it without an active internet connection after the initial page load.

tools.regex-tester.metadata.title: Regex Tester
tools.regex-tester.metadata.description: Test regular expressions with live highlighting and match info
tools.regex-tester.guide.introduction.p1: The Regex Tester is an online tool for writing, testing, and debugging regular expressions in real time. Type a pattern and a test string, and the tool instantly highlights all matches, shows match details including capture groups, and lets you test find-and-replace operations.
tools.regex-tester.guide.introduction.p2: This tool uses the JavaScript regular expression engine, so your patterns behave exactly as they would in JavaScript, TypeScript, or Node.js code. It is ideal for developers building validation rules, parsing logic, or text transformations.
tools.regex-tester.guide.howToUse.title: How to Use the Regex Tester
Enter your regular expression pattern in the Pattern field. The tool wraps it in forward slashes automatically.
Toggle flags using the checkboxes: g (global), i (case-insensitive), m (multiline), s (dotAll), and u (unicode).
Paste or type your test string in the text area below. Matches are highlighted instantly in the Highlighted Matches section.
Scroll down to see a numbered list of every match, its position in the string, and any captured groups.
Click Show Replace Mode to enter a replacement pattern. The tool shows the result of applying your regex replacement to the entire test string.
Use the Common Patterns sidebar to load pre-built patterns for emails, URLs, phone numbers, IP addresses, dates, and hex colors.
tools.regex-tester.guide.flags.title: Understanding Regex Flags
tools.regex-tester.guide.flags.body: The global flag (g) finds all matches instead of stopping at the first one. Case-insensitive (i) ignores letter casing. Multiline (m) makes ^ and $ match line boundaries. DotAll (s) makes the dot character match newlines. Unicode (u) enables full Unicode matching for characters outside the basic Latin set.
tools.regex-tester.guide.tips.title: Tips for Writing Better Regular Expressions
tools.regex-tester.guide.tips.items.0: Start with a simple pattern and refine it incrementally while watching the matches update
tools.regex-tester.guide.tips.items.1: Use capture groups with parentheses to extract specific parts of a match
tools.regex-tester.guide.tips.items.2: Test edge cases by including unusual input in your test string
tools.regex-tester.guide.tips.items.3: Use the replace mode to verify that your regex-based transformations produce correct output
tools.regex-tester.guide.tips.items.4: Check the error message area if your pattern is invalid, as it shows the exact JavaScript error
tools.regex-tester.guide.useCases.title: Common Use Cases
Validating email addresses, URLs, or phone numbers in form input
Extracting data from log files or structured text
Building search-and-replace operations for code refactoring
Learning regular expression syntax with instant visual feedback
tools.regex-tester.faqs.0.question: How do I test a regex pattern online?
tools.regex-tester.faqs.0.answer: Enter your pattern in the Pattern field and paste your test text below it. The tool highlights all matches in real time and shows detailed match information including index positions and capture groups.
tools.regex-tester.faqs.1.question: What regex engine does this tester use?
tools.regex-tester.faqs.1.answer: This tool uses the native JavaScript RegExp engine. Patterns behave identically to how they run in JavaScript, TypeScript, and Node.js, making it ideal for web development testing.
tools.regex-tester.faqs.2.question: How do I use capture groups in regex?
tools.regex-tester.faqs.2.answer: Wrap part of your pattern in parentheses to create a capture group. For example, (\d{4})-(\d{2}) captures a year and month separately. The tool displays captured groups for each match below the highlighted results.
tools.regex-tester.faqs.3.question: Can I do regex find and replace with this tool?
tools.regex-tester.faqs.3.answer: Yes. Click Show Replace Mode, enter your replacement pattern using $1, $2 for group references, and the tool shows the replaced output in real time. You can copy the result with one click.
tools.regex-tester.faqs.4.question: What does the global flag (g) do in regex?
tools.regex-tester.faqs.4.answer: The global flag tells the regex engine to find all matches in the string instead of stopping after the first one. Without it, only the first match is returned.
tools.regex-tester.faqs.5.question: How do I match an email address with regex?
tools.regex-tester.faqs.5.answer: Click the Email button in the Common Patterns sidebar to load a standard email-matching pattern. You can then modify it to fit your specific validation needs and test it against sample email addresses.
